scope: Bounded ERC4626 deposit-sample fallback and Balancer V3 natural-reference supplement. Correctness only; not full Family, formal Adapter Replay/merge, opportunity or performance acceptance.

finding.baseline: Base read already previewed 1000000 and 1000000000000000000 raw, but active proof tried only the first viable preview. Both named vaults preview the tiny amount positively yet reject its actual deposit. A view result is not a proof that this amount is executable.
finding.evidence: At the identical historical source, actor and request shape, both vaults reject 1000000 raw with 0xdcab82e2...00002aff and accept 1000000000000000000 raw with matching actual debit, share receipt, supply and Deposit event. 9055 also rejects 2000000 raw while 2411 accepts it, so there is no universal 2000000 threshold.
finding.change: Keep the first sample. Only a completed deterministic deposit revert permits one additional already-previewed sample. No unbounded search, protocol address exception, P change or output funding. Successful initial deposits do not retry. Source, required results, debit/output, event, supply and roundtrip checks stay enforced.
finding.failureIsolation: A transport failure is not a deterministic revert. When no direction has been proved, unresolved evidence remains retryable. An optional fallback failure or malformed ABI does not revoke an already-proven redeem; only ABI decoding is isolated, not source/completeness/effect checks.
finding.genericBudget: The existing proxy path can need base -> implementation slot -> implementation code -> active -> fallback. The default generic identity-step ceiling changes 4 to 5, without a protocol branch. Explicit caller limit 4 still applies and a sixth step is stopped before its requests. Dependent-read-round limit stays 4.
finding.cost: One bounded behavior retry and a higher cumulative per-variant work ceiling are real added work. Per-batch limits and concurrency are unchanged. No performance improvement or acceptability is inferred.
